verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's pricing page lists "Enhanced mass deployment (MSI)" as a feature, which is first-party evidence of MSI-based fleet deployment. It is only a single feature-list line, with no documentation of preset configuration, silent-install parameters, or deploying the client through MDM. missing for 10: documented preset configuration/policy assignment at install, documented silent install switches, MDM-based client deployment, in-depth deployment docs and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can mass-deploy the client with preset configuration through MSI, MDM, or a documented silent install
